audit_items.proof_trace: All P2P blocks undergo multi-stage validation: GossipVerifiedBlock verifies proposer signature (L1012-1018), SignatureVerifiedBlock verifies all body signatures via BlockSignatureVerifier (L1227-1230), and RPC chain segments verify all signatures in bulk (L674). NoVerification is used only after upstream signature checks or for trusted local operations (state reconstruction, fork revert, block production).
